data.label: PhysicsFS
data.description: PhysicsFS 是一个可移植、灵活的文件 I/O 抽象库。它提供一个写入目录和由多个读取目录组成的搜索路径，禁止访问指定目录之外的文件，并可将 ZIP 等归档文件透明地作为目录结构使用。

data.label: PhysicsFS
data.description: PhysicsFS is a portable, flexible file I/O abstraction library. It provides a single write directory and a search path of read directories, denies file access outside the specified directories, and lets archives such as ZIP files be used transparently as directory structures.
